name: VINAC Link
description: VINAC Link tools for OpenClaw agents: messages and intent-checked requests between paired computers, through the node that runs VINAC Link. No pairing confirmation, secret values, firewall changes or unpairing.

nodeId.description: Exact id of the node that runs VINAC Link. Optional; by default the one connected node that offers vinac.status is used.

nodeName.description: Display name of that node, used when nodeId is not set.

frontDesk.description: Opt-in: put a short note (never message text) into an agent session and wake it when VINAC Link items arrive or wait for the person. Approvals stay on the VINAC Link page.

sessionKey.description: Session that gets the notes. Default agent:main:main.

agentId.description: Agent to wake (default: the session's agent).

waitSeconds.description: Long-poll wait per node call. Default 25.

retrySeconds.description: Wait after an error (node offline). Default 30.

minWakeSeconds.description: At most one wake per this many seconds. Default 60.

notifyWaiting.description: Note items waiting for approval (count only). Default true.

wakeOnMessages.description: Note new visible messages. Default true.

notify.description: Where the woken agent's reply goes, like heartbeat delivery (target, to, accountId). Default: the configured heartbeat destination.
